title: Kadison's problem and ergodicity of the bicentralizer flow and
summary: We solve Kadison's problem on the existence of maximal abelian subalgebras in irreducible subfactors $N \subset M$ when $N$ is AFD or when $N$ is with expectation in $M$. In the latter case, we first show that the relative bicentralizer flow of a type $\mathrm{III}_1$ irreducible subfactor with expectation is always ergodic. This also implies that for every irreducible subfactor with expectation $N \subset M$, there exists an AFD subfactor with expectation $P \subset N$ that is irreducible in $M$.
